detailed_descriptions.en: Due to the invasion of the Demon Lord, countries around the world have been destroyed. In the last remaining country, a hero is summoned. Players control the hero, gather allies, and set out on a journey to defeat the Demon Lord. Can the seemingly weak protagonist indeed vanquish the Demon Lord? With over 10 playable allies and turn-based command battle, you can raise your favorite characters, traverse vast maps, and save the world! Numerous beautiful female allies Selectable difficulty Symbol encounter style Classic JRPG Full Voices

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Due to the invasion of the Demon Lord, countries around the world have been destroyed.

In the last remaining country, a hero is summoned.

Players control the hero, gather allies, and set out on a journey to defeat the Demon Lord.

Can the seemingly weak protagonist indeed vanquish the Demon Lord?

With over 10 playable allies and turn-based command battle, you can raise your favorite characters, traverse vast maps, and save the world!

  • Numerous beautiful female allies

  • Selectable difficulty

  • Symbol encounter style

  • Classic JRPG

  • Full Voices
